critical_code_review_comments: Operations.jsx likely misclassifies many records into rakanOps when account identifiers are empty/null; this can zero out workshopOps and hide cards.
Dashboard.jsx contains contradictory state in observed runs (stats non-zero while cards empty), indicating a filtering/rendering logic defect rather than pure API availability.
Layout page customization path can still surface raw injected labels in UI, so sanitization is incomplete beyond useRecentPages filtering.

Confirmed via browser fetch that /api/vehicles returned 119 and /api/operations returned 8 while UI intermittently rendered 0 cards on Dashboard/Operations. rca of the issue: RCA (likely): (1) Operations list: workshop/rakan partitioning likely treats empty account IDs as rakan via set-membership on empty string, causing active workshop list to be empty; (2) Dashboard: rendered filteredVehicles becomes empty despite available data in some runs (observed mismatch between API data/stats and card rendering), indicating client-side filter/render defect or stale UI state race; (3) Raw DOM-CHECK labels are still injected through customization/local content path outside useRecentPages.
